meta.title: Become a BT Wholesale Customer | BT Wholesale
meta.description: Join BT Wholesale and unlock access to the UK's largest network. Get high-quality services, unrivalled network reach, and dedicated support to grow your business.

pageHero.heading: Become a BT Wholesale customer
pageHero.description: We've got the support, innovation and resources to help you sell more.

items.heading: High-quality and reliable services
items.description: Access a portfolio of products and services designed to meet the needs of your customers, backed by industry-leading SLAs and the UK's most trusted network.

items.heading: An unrivalled network
items.description: We invest £2bn in our network each year, bringing connectivity to places other providers can't reach — giving your customers the coverage they need.

items.heading: Faster revenue generation
items.description: We've simplified access to our network and improved installation and lead times, so you can start generating revenue from day one.

items.heading: Unbeatable support
items.description: We've got over 1,700 specialists dedicated to delivering the best solutions and support for your business, whenever you need us.

products.heading: Our products
products.description: Unlock a comprehensive portfolio of wholesale products and services to grow your business and meet your customers' needs.

items.label: Data
items.description: High-speed data connectivity solutions including Broadband, Ethernet, SoGEA, and Optical.

items.label: Voice
items.description: Next-generation voice services — scalable, easy-to-use, and secure for all your customers.

items.label: Hosted Communications
items.description: Cloud-based communications platforms that keep your customers connected wherever they are.

items.label: Managed Services
items.description: End-to-end managed solutions that simplify complexity and free your customers to focus on growth.

items.label: Mobile
items.description: Flexible mobile solutions with nationwide coverage to keep your customers connected on the move.

items.label: Internet of Things (IoT)
items.description: Connected device solutions that unlock new business opportunities for you and your customers.

items.heading: Track record of innovation
items.description: We've been providing high-quality telecoms services since 1846, continuously innovating to stay ahead of the market and deliver what your customers need.

items.heading: The ultimate reach
items.description: We're the only UK network to offer 99.999% availability, with coverage that reaches places other providers simply can't match.

items.heading: Bespoke solutions
items.description: We work with you to create tailored solutions that meet your specific business needs and the unique requirements of your customers.

apply.heading: What we'll need from you
apply.description: Getting started is straightforward. To set up your account we'll need the following information from you.
requirements: Your contact details — name, email address and phone number
Your business information — company registration number, VAT number and reseller code
Your business needs — the products and services you're interested in
Agreement to move your BT account to BT Wholesale
